title: The voyage-craft note states the build commit and the predict restore as measured
intention: The standing voyage-craft note states the build commit and the predict's restore step as they were measured to run, so the rehearsal reader is not taught two steps that are false.
why: Akien's foreground call F46, relayed by peer akiendelllinux_cc_0 on 2026-10-08: "fix the note before d80360". 996668eceef1's measured_at_build (6) and (7) show the note it shipped states two steps that are false. Clause 1 says the build commit stages only writes_to files, but 087752e1 itself carried six resealed validations from the pre-commit hook. Clause 4 says to restore with `git show A:<path> > <path>`, which artifactgate refuses when the path is a charter. The note is standing input to every rehearsal, so d80360's passes would spend gaps on the note's own errors and spoil the measurement 996668 exists for.
traces_to: Law 3 (the note states what was measured); Law 1 (a false standing note makes every rehearsal re-derive the true step); CP1.
how: cairn/machines/rehearsal/voyage_craft.md only, two line replacements, exactly as builder_notes gives them. Clause 1's build bullet names the pre-commit hook's validation records as expected in the build commit. Clause 4 step 4 restores with `git checkout A -- <path>`, removes a build-new file with `git rm -q <path>`, and keeps every rm in a command that does not name the ~/.cairn venv. One new proof, test_the_voyage_craft_states_what_was_measured.py, with two teeth that red on the old text.
falsifier: Proof cairn/machines/rehearsal/proofs/test_the_voyage_craft_states_what_was_measured.py, PROVES {'6e587f28ebbc': {'1','2'}}. (1) In voyage_craft.md, clause 1's build-commit bullet names the pre-commit hook and the validation records it stages into the build commit, and no longer says the build commit stages only the writes_to files. (2) Clause 4 step 4's restore command carries no shell redirect, and its removal command is `git rm`. Run in a scratch git repo with A as the first commit, the restore brings back A's bytes of a path named intention+why.json, and the removal removes a file that is new at the second commit. Hollow: voyage_craft.md reverted to the proof commit reds teeth 1 and 2. The four teeth of test_the_reader_is_handed_the_voyage_craft.py stay green. Horizon: d80360545e91's rehearsal raises no gap about the build commit's contents or the predict's restore step.
builder_notes: WHERE: cairn/machines/rehearsal/voyage_craft.md only. Replace the clause 1 line '   - the build commit stages only the ticket's writes_to files, never a proof. Message: `<ticket id>: build — <ticket title>`.' with '   - the build commit stages the ticket's writes_to files, never a proof. Message: `<ticket id>: build — <ticket title>`. The pre-commit hook reseals the component's proofs and stages their validation records into this same commit; that is expected, and the builder does not unstage them.' Replace the clause 4 line '   4. Overwrite each writes_to file from A with `git show A:<path> > <path>`. A file that is new in the build is removed instead.' with '   4. Restore each writes_to file from A with `git checkout A -- <path>`. A file that is new in the build is removed instead with `git rm -q <path>`. Keep every `rm` and `git rm` in a command of its own: a command that also names the ~/.cairn venv is refused by the delete gate.' The proof parses clause 4 step 4 by its backticked spans: the restore is the span holding ' A' and '<path>', and the removal is the span starting 'git rm'. Its scratch repo comes from cairn.tools.scratch.scratch.scratch_dir, never tempfile, and commits with `git -c user.name=t -c user.email=t@t`. Reseal every rehearsal proof after the build.

decisions.text: In cairn/machines/rehearsal/voyage_craft.md replace the clause 1 line '   - the build commit stages only the ticket's writes_to files, never a proof. Message: `<ticket id>: build — <ticket title>`.' with '   - the build commit stages the ticket's writes_to files, never a proof. Message: `<ticket id>: build — <ticket title>`. The pre-commit hook reseals the component's proofs and stages their validation records into this same commit; that is expected, and the builder does not unstage them.'

In cairn/machines/rehearsal/voyage_craft.md replace the clause 4 line '   4. Overwrite each writes_to file from A with `git show A:<path> > <path>`. A file that is new in the build is removed instead.' with '   4. Restore each writes_to file from A with `git checkout A -- <path>`. A file that is new in the build is removed instead with `git rm -q <path>`. Keep every `rm` and `git rm` in a command of its own: a command that also names the ~/.cairn venv is refused by the delete gate.' No other line of the note changes.

The proof cairn/machines/rehearsal/proofs/test_the_voyage_craft_states_what_was_measured.py is written and committed; its last proof commit is 9bab3274, which is A for the predict. At 9bab3274 tooth 2 lifts the <path> placeholder out before it looks for a redirect, because the placeholder's own '>' redded the corrected restore. Measured: red 2/2 on the old note, green 2/2 on the corrected one. The build does not touch the proof.
